main.subject: You're in. Here's lesson 1
main.preview: Your course login, your Feeding Schedule and The Crumb Room.
paragraphs: Hey {{contact.first_name}},
You're in. Here's everything in one place:

1. Your course: [Open my course](login).
This link signs you in and works for 24 hours. The first time, you'll choose your password.
After that, [log in here](course) with {{contact.email}}. No password yet? Click "Forgot password" on that page.
2. Your printable Feeding Schedule: it's inside your course. Print it and stick it on the fridge.
3. The Crumb Room, my private Facebook group: [Join The Crumb Room](community).
Do one thing today: watch lesson 1. The lessons are short, and you've got bread to bake this weekend.
Nora
P.S. Starter acting up? Stuck on anything? Email me at hello@bellandcrumb.test.
